scope: Correct pinned absence-label inference at surviving parentheses in aggregation parameters. No new language function, retained state, cache, ABI/provider/storage contract, resource cap or dependency.

runtime.cause: Preprocessing deliberately leaves aggregation Param subtrees unvisited. The sole inference caller passed the raw AST argument, then absence::labels unconditionally removed parentheses, inferring labels that the pinned source does not infer.
runtime.correction: The evaluator resolves its existing Prepared.preprocessing.child edge and passes that immediate node. Absence inference no longer performs a second unconditional parenthesis traversal.
runtime.preserved: Ordinary visited calls still remove argument parentheses; the generic unvisited-matrix path, subquery inference, matcher history, empty and byte labels, spans, schedules and provider behavior retain their existing owners.

reproduction.dataset: Three distinct m float series with id=a/b/c, job=worker and values1/2/3 at1000/2000ms; no missing metric.
reproduction.topk_before: Rust runtime Parameter value is NaN; pinned Go returns the largest two m series.
reproduction.quantile_before: Rust returns NaN plus warning; pinned Go returns3 without a warning.
reproduction.meaningful_regression: A test-only Debug build executes the new whole-query regression and fails at the exact NaN-parameter error. Its copied executable, source and stderr byte-vector error are retained. The corrected regression passes48 complete typed combinations across pages, modes and delayed-name settings.

original_evidence.lineage: Fresh evaluations reuse the unchanged pinned Go1.27.1 AMD64 oracle and verified retained compiler/source/helper binding; no new build is claimed.
original_evidence.panel_scope: Both parser profiles and instant/range; four matcher forms at three parenthesis depths, topk/quantile parameters, present/missing data, ordinary selector/matrix calls, generic parenthesized matrix/subquery and computed controls.

native_comparisons.meaning: The previous runtime fails32 of144 original cases for each native profile/page. All corrected complete outcomes and diagnostics match the pinned original; earlier failures are not counted as supported cases.

foreign_scope.meaning: Actual compiled ARM64/ARM32 library execution under QEMU in both profiles; selected units and short callers, not full foreign suites or Agent builds.

c_scope.meaning: Collected topk/quantile results, exact labels/bits/clocks, instant/range, pages1/17/1024 and provider-failure cleanup. The default full C roster is unchanged and not claimed rerun.

resource_interpretation: Among672 groups whose result is unchanged, reads are exact and no measured work/allocation/peak increases. Restoring192 previously wrong error/NaN outcomes legitimately does more evaluation and output work; their costs are recorded separately, not presented as matched-semantics speedups. Counters are engine observations, not process RSS or DBengine disk I/O.
footprint: Native query-fixture ELF .text increases16bytes in each profile. No new type field or retained allocation representation is introduced; this is not installed Agent footprint.
limitations: Finite same-input compatibility evidence; no arbitrary-input or whole-language proof.
No throughput timing claim is made for a correctness correction or for changed semantic outcomes.
Memory/work comparisons distinguish unchanged results from restored valid executions; total query memory and RSS are not universally bounded by raw paging.
Historical broader language, SRE, API, live-Agent, sanitizer and CI cohorts retain their exact identities. No fresh full-Agent or CI pass follows.
The old-regression reader initially expected a textual panic in stdout; the byte-vector error was correctly verified in closed stderr without a test rerun.
